source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: NF1 neuropathy (formerly neurofibromatous neuropathy) is a rare (2-3%), adult-onset, non-progressive, symmetrical length-dependent sensorimotor polyneuropathy that is painless in most patients.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 109 Ferner 2004 PMID 15520408. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 109
